scope: initial measured improvement on authored family-disjoint English evaluation, not production or coding savings
train_sources: families.json train; all viewed earlier final tests are development training
selection: Validation mean NLL plus mean cross-order Jensen-Shannon divergence (weight 1), using all six orders; both seeds frozen before final check
failure_policy: Do not lower criteria; a viewed test becomes development data, require a new family holdout for a new cycle. Preserve all failures.
calibration_policy: New eight-family 24-case calibration; prior calibration becomes validation. Same temperature grid and 0.9 gate for base and tuned.
